This place fixes a bad travel day fast.

Versailles - Beach Club Phú Quốc sits right on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo with sand underfoot, cold drinks in hand, and the kind of slow afternoon that makes you forget your flight home exists.

4.6 stars across 443 reviews. $15-30 a head. That's a full beach club meal without the resort markup.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
